caption:
An India-born CEO's company just trained 5.6 million Indians in AI skills. Already well past the goal it set a year earlier.

Satya Nadella's Microsoft has trained 5.6 million people in India through its ADVANTA(I)GE India program since January 2025 - enabling more than 125,000 individuals to secure jobs or start businesses. That blew past the original goal of training 10 million by 2030, so Microsoft doubled it to 20 million. The push sits inside a broader $17.5 billion investment in India's AI infrastructure, cloud capacity and workforce training through 2029.

A training target set for 2030 usually takes years to approach. This one was already beaten before the halfway mark.

Sources: Nasdaq/Reuters, Benzatine (2026)
